scope: Targeted primary-source research for RECAP-CIM development, not a complete systematic review

sources.title: Key Questions on Energy and AI
sources.finding: Data-centre demand projection of roughly 485 TWh in 2025 and 950 TWh in 2030 motivates careful energy accounting.
sources.limits: Macro-level context, not an estimate of TinyML climate savings.

sources.title: The Global E-waste Monitor 2024
sources.finding: 62 million tonnes of e-waste in 2022 and 22.3% formally collected/recycled.
sources.limits: Total electronics waste. Batteryless device lifetime benefits require separate lifecycle evidence.

sources.title: 3GPP TS 38.291 NR Ambient IoT Physical layer
sources.finding: Ambient IoT has a Release 19 physical-layer specification, with version 19.3.0 uploaded 2026-03-20.
sources.limits: Standards signal. No inference compute budget or CNN capability inferred from the specification listing.

sources.title: MLPerf Tiny: Benchmarking AI at the Edge
sources.finding: v1.4 release covers five tasks; streaming wake word includes idle/listening behaviour.
sources.limits: Benchmark scope verified. No MLPerf compliance claim for the current research preprocessing.

sources.title: STM32N6 series
sources.finding: Commercial MCU-integrated NPU and deployment toolchain provide a reference for modern edge AI.
sources.limits: Vendor peak performance is separate from batteryless operation and full-system measurements.

sources.title: TinyML Hits the Memory Wall: A Benchmark of Ten Sub-Watt Edge Devices
sources.finding: Authors report memory-traffic correlation on four accelerator systems and a small CNN suite.
sources.limits: Submitted 2026-11-02. Small-model correlation and energy above idle limit generalization.

sources.title: Special Session - Intermittent TinyML: Powering Sustainable Deep Intelligence Without Batteries
sources.finding: Research agenda includes intermittent inference, communication, CIM and lifecycle effects.
sources.limits: Full PDF opened. Repeated PDF find operations timed out. No systematic-review completeness claim.

sources.title: Chime: Checkpointing Long Computations on Intermittently Energized IoT Devices
sources.finding: Optimized checkpoint placement and adaptive checkpoint rates precede RECAP.
sources.limits: A periodic control is insufficient to represent the optimized algorithm.

sources.title: A Tale of Two Domains: Exploring Efficient Architecture Design for Truly Autonomous Things (CHRYSALIS)
sources.locator: Section IV and intermittent mapping description
sources.finding: Co-explores energy-harvesting hardware, inference hardware and dataflow/tiling with checkpoint costs.
sources.limits: PDF sections were retrieved earlier in the session; author PDF access became intermittent on recheck. A common-backend adaptation needs an explicit state/action/objective mapping.

sources.title: Intermittent-Aware Neural Architecture Search (iNAS)
sources.finding: Co-explores model architecture, execution design and preservation design.
sources.limits: Repository availability verified, executable baseline not reproduced in this review.

sources.title: Everything Leaves Footprints: Hardware Accelerated Intermittent Deep Inference (HAWAII)
sources.finding: Inference progress footprinting and recovery on an MSP430FR5994 with LEA.
sources.limits: MCU/accelerator state contract differs from a volatile SRAM-CIM bank.

sources.title: Memory-efficient Energy-adaptive Inference of Pre-Trained Models on Batteryless Embedded Systems (FreeML)
sources.finding: Compression plus a shared early-exit branch supports memory-efficient energy adaptation.
sources.limits: Accuracy-adaptive comparison needs a different output contract from exact INT8 completion.

sources.title: Exploring fine to medium granularity checkpointing for CNNs inferences in intermittent systems with Circadia
sources.locator: Abstract; Circadia; compilation chain; experiments previews
sources.finding: CNN-static dataflow and live-state analysis support linear-complexity checkpoint placement and granularity exploration.
sources.limits: Full method and code not retrieved. Publisher access intermittently 403; Inria artifact denied.

sources.title: Adaptive Computing in Memory Meets Conventional Batteryless Platforms (Viadotto)
sources.finding: Adaptive CRAM-based CIM integration with MCU batteryless platforms and compiler/controller support.
sources.limits: Nonvolatile CRAM changes recovery costs. Full PDF opened; later find calls timed out.

sources.title: Energy-Adaptive Checkpoint-Free Intermittent Inference for Low Power Energy Harvesting Systems
sources.locator: Sections on loop indices and consistency-aware idempotent execution
sources.finding: Progress variables and durable intermediate data support a checkpoint-free-labelled execution mechanism.
sources.limits: The label does not imply zero persistence. Compare actual writes, atomic regions and pruning-induced accuracy effects.

sources.title: Power- and Deadline-Aware Dynamic Inference on Intermittent Computing Systems (DualAdaptNet)
sources.finding: Width/depth adaptation and runtime scheduling jointly address power and deadlines.
sources.limits: Accepted manuscript restricted until 2026-11-19 per repository. Detailed algorithm not verified.

sources.title: Catch Non-determinism If You Can: Intermittent Inference of Dynamic Neural Networks (NodPA)
sources.finding: Dynamic execution requires indicators capturing nondeterministic progress and storage locations.
sources.limits: Direct DOI access 403; substantial publisher-indexed excerpts available. No code reproduction.

sources.title: BISen: A Robust Framework for Efficient CNN Inference on Battery-Free Intelligent Sensory Nodes
sources.finding: Energy-aware safe-stop and selective CNN state preservation constitute a strong reactive comparison family.
sources.limits: Publisher direct access requires JavaScript; staging excerpts retrieved. Linked code identity/access not verified.

sources.title: Intermittent Inference: Trading a 1% Accuracy Loss for a 1.9x Throughput Speedup (INTERCEPT)
sources.finding: Compile-time persistence placement/configuration trades STT-MRAM write energy against inference accuracy.
sources.limits: Requires a technology-specific write-error model. Exact-output contract differs.

sources.title: Forget Failure: Exploiting SRAM Data Remanence for Low-overhead Intermittent Computation (TotalRecall)
sources.finding: Residual charge can preserve MCU SRAM during some off intervals, with NVM fallback.
sources.limits: ASPLOS 2020 publication date verified from PDF. MCU SRAM result is not calibration of a CIM macro.

sources.title: Efficient task-based intermittent computing leveraging SRAM data retention (RIPPLE)
sources.finding: Energy-aware backups and validation of retained SRAM state reduce persistence overhead.
sources.limits: Published 2026-02-06. Full text paywalled. Listed GitHub repository was empty on inspection.

sources.title: CIM-Tuner: Balancing the Compute and Storage Capacity of SRAM-CIM Accelerator via Hardware-mapping Co-exploration
sources.finding: ICW/WUW and two-level tiling expose compute and weight-update costs.
sources.limits: Treat as preprint for this review. Framework abstraction is not measured system calibration.

sources.title: AccelCIM: Systematic Dataflow Exploration for SRAM Compute-in-Memory Accelerator
sources.finding: Dataflow, macro/array costs and compute-I/O overlap must be evaluated together.
sources.limits: Preprint version used. Reported layout/simulation costs belong to the authors' backend.

sources.title: FERMI-ML: A Flexible and Resource-Efficient Memory-In-Situ SRAM Macro for TinyML acceleration
sources.finding: Flexible digital SRAM macro uses approximate arithmetic and reports post-layout results.
sources.limits: Digital implementation alone does not establish exact INT8 compatibility.

sources.title: SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory
sources.finding: Precision/control and early termination already form an active SRAM-CIM research direction.
sources.limits: Submitted 2026-10-27. Claims are author-reported synthesis/PnR/system estimates. Early exit is within accumulation and must be distinguished from network branch exits.

sources.title: ZigZag-IMC
sources.locator: Important Notice; hardware cost model limitations
sources.finding: SRAM digital/analog architecture models with explicit integer/adder/cell constraints and validation references.
sources.limits: No setup or integration performed. CACTI platform limitation and model scope require attention.

sources.title: CiMLoop project maintenance notice
sources.finding: Repository directs new architecture work to AccelForge and component models to HWComponents.
sources.limits: Keep original paper citation and pin the implementation version chosen.

sources.title: AccelForge and HWComponents
sources.finding: Maintained tensor-accelerator mapping and hardware-component cost tools are potential offline backends.
sources.limits: Integration and cost validation remain future work.

sources.title: FM25V20A-G F-RAM
sources.finding: 2-Mbit serial FRAM provides a concrete transaction-cost reference.
sources.limits: 2 Mbit equals 256 KiB. Full board energy and G8's 2 MiB store need an explicit implementation.

sources.title: IEEE Embedded Systems Letters author instructions
sources.finding: Novel technical depth and a submission length of four pages including references.
sources.limits: Venue fit is conditional on the scientific result.

sources.title: IEEE TCAD paper submission instructions
sources.finding: Algorithms/tools for automated circuit and system design fit TCAD; regular submissions up to 14 pages.
sources.limits: A longer submission requires a correspondingly substantial research contribution.

status: Literature review and diagnostic complete; proposed G9 experiment remains a draft
